title: Hour buttons look big and invasive
body:
Hi. In my 5.5" Full HD phone the hour buttons look big and invasive... could them be just white without the big grey box behind them?
Or, even better, with text modified in "24 H    12 H   6 H   3 H ", eventually in a smaller darker grey box?
The screen is already filled with informations, graphs and symbols, so perhaps this can reduce a bit the crowding...

**As it is now:**
![before](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/32884006/38447590-92dd0090-39fe-11e8-9998-799cd576264c.jpg)

**As I propose:**
![after](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/32884006/38447594-970169b8-39fe-11e8-8c8d-a37c860fafb6.jpg)

Thank you. Pippo :-)

Bye. Pippo  :-)
@ANDREAPIPPI is this a mockup or did you do this in code?

@ANDREAPIPPI can you compile your own xDrip from sourcecode?

The text on the button depens on one line in strings.xml (./app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml)
`<string name="hour_format">%s Hour</string>`

You could change it to:
`<string name="hour_format">%s H</string>`

... and see how it looks.

cheers,
Adrian
